questions.question: Tourism is often described as an 'invisible export' for a country because:
options: Tourists travel only during night flights without passport checks
It involves smuggling of ancient cultural artefacts
It earns substantial foreign exchange through services provided to international visitors without exporting physical goods
It cannot be accounted for in national income statistics
questions.explanation: International visitors purchase services such as accommodation, food and transport within the destination country. These service receipts can earn foreign exchange without a physical good being exported. The 'invisible export' label is an extended economics term used to explain this mechanism.
questions.citation: NCERT Class 10 Geography, Contemporary India-II, Chapter 7, Lifelines of National Economy (Reprint 2026–27)
